details: Batch for Wed Nov 25 sent, waiting for approval
summary: Last 7 days (Nov 18 to 24): 35 reels were posted and 16 could be counted; the other 19 show almost no views in the stats tool, all of them books that had already run in this format. The 16 counted reels drew 5,091 views in total, typically about 150 each. Typical 3-second hold was 17.1%, down from 21.0% the week before (Nov 11 to 17). In the block that just ended, the edition-fact opening (O5) held 21.6% over 693 views against 16.7% over 1,365 views for the champion number-fact opening (O1): 4.9 points ahead, short of the 8 points needed to win. Most O5 reels ran on books shown for the first time while the O1 reels were repeats, so the comparison is weak. Best recent reel by hold: The Sealed Nectar, 24.3% (141 views). Worst: Tafsir as-Sa'di, 9.5% (125 views). Both are small samples. Today's batch tests O6, the spine shown first, against O1 on five books.
change: Block 4 called: the champion O1 (a count from the book on screen) stays. The challenger O5 (language, binding and publisher on screen) was ahead by 4.9 points of 3-second hold, 21.6% on 693 views against 16.7% on 1,365, under the 8 points needed, so nothing in the formula changes. The call is provisional until Friday's recheck, and whether O5 gets a rematch waits for the owner's decision. The next block tests O6, the spine shown in the first second before the cover.
